mapper.select: select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p join sys_role_permission rp on p.id = rp.sys_permission_id where p.deleted = 0 and rp.deleted = 0 and rp.sys_role_id = #{role_id}

select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p join sys_user_permission up on p.id = up.sys_permission_id where p.deleted = 0 and up.deleted = 0 and up.sys_user_id = #{user_id}

select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p join sys_user_permission up on p.id = up.sys_permission_id where p.deleted = 0 and up.deleted = 0 and up.sys_user_id = #{user_id} union select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p where p.deleted = 0 and p.id in ( select rp.sys_permission_id from sys_role_permission rp join sys_user_role ur on rp.sys_role_id = ur.sys_role_id where rp.deleted = 0 and ur.deleted = 0 and ur.sys_user_id = #{user_id} )

select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p join sys_user_permission up on p.id = up.sys_permission_id where p.deleted = 0 and up.deleted = 0 and up.sys_user_id in ( select u.id from sys_user u where u.username = #{username} and u.deleted = 0 )

select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p join sys_user_permission up on p.id = up.sys_permission_id where p.deleted = 0 and up.deleted = 0 and up.sys_user_id in ( select u.id from sys_user u where u.username = #{username} and u.deleted = 0 ) union select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.view, p.modify from sys_permission p where p.deleted = 0 and p.id in ( select rp.sys_permission_id from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.sys_role_id = ur.sys_role_id inner join sys_user u on u.id = ur.sys_user_id where ur.deleted = 0 and rp.deleted = 0 and u.deleted = 0 and u.username = #{username} )
